instruction: isbns.txt holds one candidate ISBN-13 per line. Write check.py printing 'valid' or 'invalid' per line: valid only for 13-digit all-numeric strings whose check digit matches the ISBN-13 rule (weights 1,3 alternating; check = (10 - sum(first 12 weighted) % 10) % 10). Run it.

grader.script:
python3 check.py > got.txt && printf 'valid
invalid
valid
invalid
invalid
invalid
' | diff - got.txt

oracle.script:
cat > check.py <<'EOF'
for ln in open('isbns.txt'):
    s = ln.strip()
    if len(s) != 13 or not s.isdigit():
        print('invalid')
        continue
    d = [int(x) for x in s]
    check = (10 - sum(x * (1 if i % 2 == 0 else 3) for i, x in enumerate(d[:12])) % 10) % 10
    print('valid' if check == d[12] else 'invalid')
EOF
python3 check.py
